SELECT
FROM sales_order o JOIN user_account u ON u.id = o.user_id JOIN order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE u.user_no = #{userNo} GROUP BY o.id, o.order_no, u.user_no, o.total_amount, o.status, o.created_at ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

SELECT
FROM sales_order o JOIN user_account u ON u.id = o.user_id JOIN order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE u.user_no = #{userNo} AND o.order_no = #{orderNo} GROUP BY o.id, o.order_no, u.user_no, o.total_amount, o.status, o.created_at
